name: Hopping / Overlapping Window Aggregations via time_bucket
description: Real-time surveillance monitors rolling 15-minute average latency stepped forward every 5 minutes (a hopping window).
prompt:
Real-time surveillance monitors rolling 15-minute average latency stepped forward every 5 minutes (a hopping window).

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: window_start, window_end, server_id, sample_count, avg_cpu, peak_cpu.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Generate 15-minute sliding windows stepped every 5 minutes (hopping window)
            WITH window_steps AS (
                SELECT UNNEST(generate_series(
                    TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01 10:00:00',
                    TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01 10:15:00',
                    INTERVAL '5 minutes'
                )) AS window_start
            )
            SELECT 
                w.window_start,
                w.window_start + INTERVAL '15 minutes' AS window_end,
                m.server_id,
                COUNT(m.cpu_utilization) AS sample_count,
                ROUND(AVG(m.cpu_utilization), 2) AS avg_cpu,
                MAX(m.cpu_utilization) AS peak_cpu
            FROM window_steps w
            JOIN server_metrics m
              ON m.metric_time >= w.window_start
             AND m.metric_time < w.window_start + INTERVAL '15 minutes'
            GROUP BY w.window_start, m.server_id
            ORDER BY w.window_start;
why_it_fails: Standard GROUP BY time_bucket only produces non-overlapping tumbling windows, missing cross-boundary bursts.
